clue.text: Have pyromaniac tendencies? Very much so!

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, someone keen on fires would be fond of things such as bonfires and infernos
an emphatic idiom meaning furiously, intensely, with great vigour

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means with great intensity, while literally it describes being drawn to fires, which is what pyromaniacs are.

clue.text: Section of Old Testament introducing short service for harvest festival

parts.note: Lam is the abbreviation for Lamentations, a book of the Old Testament

indicators.note: short means the service word loses its last letter

parts.note: Mass is a church service
the final S of the service word is the letter dropped

explanation.surface: Part of the Bible starts a brief church service for a harvest celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Lammas, 1 August, was the English festival when loaves from the first wheat were blessed.

clue.text: Fruit essential, we're told, to one's internal well-being principally

indicators.note: we're told means the word for essential is only heard, giving its sound

parts.note: key means essential or crucial

indicators.note: principally means only the first letter of well-being is used

parts.note: one is I, and one's is I'S, written IS

explanation.surface: Claims that fruit is vital to keep your insides healthy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we're told' marks only the first piece as spoken; 'internal' puts the leading letter of well-being inside one's, and 'principally' takes that letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Kiwis are the green fuzzy-skinned fruit also called Chinese gooseberries.

clue.text: Carriers such as EasyJet move freely in Israel after conclusion of agreement

indicators.note: after means the rearranged letters follow the final letter of agreement

parts.note: to budge is to move slightly

indicators.note: conclusion of means only the last letter of agreement is used
freely means the letters of in and Israel are rearranged at will

explanation.surface: Low-cost flights roam without restriction in Israel once a deal is done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freely' is the anagram signal, 'conclusion of' takes the final T of agreement, and 'after' sets the rearranged letters behind it. EasyJet is a British low-cost airline.
explanation.definitionFit: EasyJet is a no-frills, low-fare carrier, an example of this category.

clue.text: Order no lager in bar

indicators.note: Order means the letters of no lager in are put into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone at a pub counter asks for something other than beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like the pub; it is a metal bar, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a length of metal with an L-shaped cross-section, a kind of structural bar.

clue.text: Aim to bring me in to produce 9?

indicators.note: bring me in means the word me goes inside the word for aim

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone hoping to be included in making some fixes.
explanation.walkthrough: 9 down is THE CORRECTIONS, so the definition means to make corrections.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit a text to remove errors is to make corrections to it, cross-referenced from another clue.

clue.text: Soldiers restraining big dog

indicators.note: restraining means the soldiers hold the other piece inside them

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve soldiers
OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize

explanation.surface: A squad of soldiers is holding back a large hound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big' looks like part of the definition, but it gives OS (outsize); 'dog' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tosa is a large Japanese mastiff breed originally kept for fighting.

clue.text: A clout, sir, will do for one making eyes

indicators.note: will do suggests the letters of a clout sir will be made into something else, an anagram

explanation.surface: A man is told a slap will do for one who flirts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one making eyes' suggests a flirt; it is a maker of artificial eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocularist is a specialist who crafts artificial glass or acrylic eyes.

clue.text: Rock named after American region, also eastern location

parts.note: and means also, in addition
a site is a location

explanation.surface: A stone bears the name of a part of America, and so does a place out east.
explanation.definitionFit: A volcanic rock named after the Andes mountain range of South America.

clue.text: Editor's proofs for award-winning novel

definitions.meaning: an editor marks fixes to errors on printed proofs
Jonathan Franzen's 2001 novel, which won the US National Book Award

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names an editor's amendments and is also the title of Franzen's National Book Award winner.

clue.text: Cut that's the fashion, so we hear

indicators.note: so we hear tells us the word for fashion is only spoken, its sound giving the entry

parts.note: a mode is a style or fashion

explanation.surface: Somebody remarks that a certain haircut is apparently in vogue.
explanation.definitionFit: To have cut grass or hay with a blade is to have mown it, a past-tense synonym.

clue.text: Dog disturbed young herd

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of the following words are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A hound has upset a group of young cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges YOUNG HERD into the racing breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim, fast breed of hound used for racing, so it is a type of canine.

clue.text: Forbidding a union leader to take control in auditorium

indicators.note: in auditorium means the phrase is heard by an audience rather than read, so its sound counts

parts.words: a union leader to take control
parts.note: A as written, U as the leading letter of union, and STEER, to take control, run together

explanation.surface: A trade union boss sternly stepping in to run things in a concert hall.
explanation.walkthrough: A + U (union's first letter) + STEER, said aloud, sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A stern, severe manner is forbidding, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Lower young woman onto platform briefly

indicators.note: onto means the young woman is placed after the shortened platform
briefly means the word for platform is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a deck is a platform, as on a ship
a lass is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: Someone is lowering a girl down onto a stage for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower someone in social rank is to demote them out of their class, a verb synonym.

clue.text: During break, school principal's first to offer support

indicators.note: first means the principal's word comes at the front of the answer

parts.note: a head is a school principal

indicators.note: During means the word for school sits within the word for break

parts.note: a rest is a break
to school someone is to train them

explanation.surface: In a recess, the head teacher is first to offer a helping hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'During' is a container signal, placing school inside break; 'first' puts principal's word in front. 'to offer' only joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The padded part on a car seat that holds up the occupant's neck and skull is a kind of support.

clue.text: Rebuilding a shelter's hard

indicators.note: Rebuilding means the letters of a shelter's are put together in a new arrangement

parts.note: the word as written, with its S kept as a letter

explanation.surface: Reconstructing a refuge's tough work.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the possessive S counts as a letter of the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard in the sense of unfeeling or pitiless is a synonym.

clue.text: Female carried across river in Dorset town

indicators.note: across means the female and carried pieces span either side of the river letter

parts.note: she is a female pronoun
borne means carried

explanation.surface: A woman is ferried over a river to a West Country town.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherborne is a market town in Dorset, a county in south-west England, known for its abbey and school.

clue.text: Penny on cereal and uncooked rolls? Maybe not, in this

definitions.text: Penny on cereal and uncooked rolls? Maybe not, in this

parts.note: rice is a cereal grain

indicators.note: rolls means the word for uncooked is turned over, reading backwards

parts.note: raw means uncooked

explanation.surface: Shop prices on breakfast food and bread are unlikely to go up in a supermarket battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rolls' looks like bread but turns RAW into WAR. In a price war, adding a penny to cereal and rolls is unlikely.
explanation.definitionFit: A price war is fierce competition where rival sellers cut prices, so no penny is added.

clue.text: On Scottish island fellow includes me in reorganisation

parts.note: re means on or about, as in business letters
Arran is an island in the Firth of Clyde, off western Scotland

indicators.note: includes means the word for fellow holds the following word inside it

parts.note: a gent is a fellow or gentleman

explanation.surface: A man on a Scottish island brings the speaker into a shake-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Shuffling things into a new order is a reorganisation, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Sound of phone in church making you feel embarrassed

indicators.note: in means the phone's sound goes inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a phone makes a ring

explanation.surface: A mobile going off during a service is mortifying.
explanation.definitionFit: To wince or shrink with awkwardness is to feel embarrassed, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Just like puss, ready to grab injured tit

indicators.note: to grab means the money word closes around the next piece

parts.note: the ready is slang for cash

indicators.note: injured means the letters of tit are knocked out of their order

explanation.surface: A cat waiting to pounce on a wounded small bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' scrambles the bird's letters and 'to grab' wraps the money around them. 'ready' looks like an adjective but is slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: Feline in manner, especially spiteful in a catty way, is what resembling a cat means.

clue.text: Chinese party taken in, duped

indicators.note: taken in means the party word is held inside the Chinese word

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A Chinese guest was fooled into going to a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in' looks like the definition 'duped' but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To have someone on is a British idiom for fooling or tricking them.

clue.text: Brewery worker who loses his nerve?

definitions.meaning: a person who fills containers with beer at a brewery
British slang: to bottle it is to lose courage, so one who does so

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a person filling beer containers and, in British slang, a coward who bottles out.

clue.text: Fire shot? Permit needed for a start

indicators.note: for a start means the permit word is placed at the beginning

parts.note: to let is to permit
a shot is a go or an attempt

explanation.surface: A gunman needs a licence before firing.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss an employee is to release them from work, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Man recruited by gardener who's taking a short break?

indicators.note: recruited by means the man is taken into the gardener's ranks, inside the word

parts.note: a weeder is a gardener pulling unwanted plants
Ken is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man joins a gardener who is off on a brief holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone away from Friday to Sunday on a brief trip is a weekend visitor, defined by the activity.

clue.text: 'Low-fat' means having to go regularly? Very regularly!

indicators.note: every other letter of the quoted words is lost, regularly, so the second, fourth and so on remain

explanation.surface: A joke about a diet food that makes one need the loo frequently.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the even letters of LOW-FAT MEANS gives O, F, T, E, N.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done many times is done frequently, a synonym.

clue.text: Republican leader remains impetuous

indicators.note: leader means only the opening letter of Republican is taken

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A Republican chief is still hot-headed.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting without thought is hasty and reckless, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Fail to achieve every goal? That'll create stress

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, to score fewer than expected, to fall short in scoring
a line drawn under words to emphasise them

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is scoring too few; as one, a line beneath text that gives it emphasis.
